question: How do will and the other powers become enjoyable within unsurpassed bliss?

When will and the rest are grounded in unsurpassed bliss, they become enjoyable.
This describes the dynamic interplay of the powers in the supreme state.
inference: In unsurpassed bliss, the powers themselves become the field of enjoyment through the collision of awareness.
